mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.5% signals a strong accommodative monetary policy, leading to increased liquidity and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the accommodative signal, or the correlation between FEDFUNDS and SPX returns is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals economic distress, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the distress signal, or the correlation between UNRATE spikes and SPX returns is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over three months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the weakening demand signal, or the correlation between RSAFS declines and SPX returns is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in one month signals strengthening supply-side fundamentals, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the strengthening supply signal, or the correlation between INDPRO increases and SPX returns is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low inflation (CPIAUCSL < 2%) and low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 1%) signals a benign monetary environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the benign monetary environment signal, or the joint effect of CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS on SPX returns is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 in one month signals strong labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the strong labor market signal, or the correlation between PAYEMS increases and SPX returns is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over three months signals strengthening demand in the housing sector, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances despite the strengthening housing demand signal, or the correlation between HOUST increases and SPX returns is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A combination of increasing industrial production (INDPRO > 1% YoY) and decreasing unemployment rate (UNRATE < 5%) signals a robust economic environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the robust economic environment signal, or the joint effect of INDPRO and UNRATE on SPX returns is not significant (p > 0.05).
